_comment: Candidate locators, tried in order until one becomes visible. Sign-in/OTP/CAPTCHA entries are carried over from Amazon_ad_targeting_report_cron, where they were verified against the live Amazon pages. The Products page entries are UNVERIFIED best guesses built from the recorded steps: when a run fails naming a key (screenshot in data/screenshots/), put the working selector at the TOP of that key's list. No code change needed. Any Playwright selector engine works: css, xpath=, text=, role=, and '>>' chaining. {label} and {n} are filled in by the code.
_note_otp: Amazon's Two-Step Verification page, verified against the live page on 2026-09-19. The OTP box is <input id='auth-mfa-otpcode' name='otpCode' type='tel'>, the submit is <input id='auth-signin-button' name='mfaSubmit'>, and 'Don't require code on this browser' is <input id='auth-mfa-remember-device' name='rememberDevice'>. Ticking that box is what stops later scheduled runs from hitting MFA again, so it matters more than it looks.
_note_captcha: Split out of security_challenge_marker: an image CAPTCHA is the one challenge a terminal cannot answer, so the interactive login has to tell it apart from an OTP.
_note_products: UNVERIFIED. cm/products?entityId=... : tabs 'Advertised products' / 'All sold products'; toolbar with Filter by, Columns, 'Date range: Oct 28, 2026' and Export; footer with 'Results per page: 25', '1-25 of 463 results' and |< < > >| arrows.
_note_filter_tag: One chip per active filter in the filter bar (verified live 2026-10-30: div#products_view:products_view:filterTag-clicks / -orders). Any chip other than REQUIRED_FILTER_TEXT is removed with its 'remove' button.
_note_date_preset: Inside the open Date range picker: the preset list on the left (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days ...). {label} is 'Today' or 'Yesterday'.
_note_results_per_page_option: Inside the open 'Results per page' list. {n} is RESULTS_PER_PAGE (200).
_note_export: If Export opens a menu or a dialog instead of downloading at once, these are tried while waiting for the file.
